LESSON 3 · 00

从空白开始，亲手做一次 PCAStart from a blank script and build your own PCA

这份教材给第一次接触编程的人。你不需要下载现成程序：我们先建一个空项目，自己写出 1 + 1，学会运行和看结果，再一小段一小段写出企鹅分析。

This guide is for someone who has never programmed. Begin with an empty project, write 1 + 1, learn to run it and read the answer, then build a penguin analysis in small steps.

开始：安装与准备 / Start here已经装好？从新建项目开始 / Already installed?

每一轮只做四件事：先猜结果 → 自己写 → 运行核对 → 改一个地方再试。看到结果不等于理解；你能说出“这行为什么在这里”，才算完成。

Use four steps: predict → write → run and check → change one thing. Seeing output is only the start; aim to explain why each line is there.

文件 / File用途 / Purpose你怎么处理 / Your action
.html 网页教材这本带截图的说明书 / This illustrated textbook用浏览器阅读；不放进 R / Read in a browser
.R 脚本你自己写的 R 指令 / Your own R instructions在 RStudio 编辑和运行 / Edit and run in RStudio
.Rproj 项目管理这次学习的文件夹 / Organises your study folder由 RStudio 创建，下次用它重开 / Create in RStudio; reopen later
.csv 数据企鹅测量表，没有程序 / Penguin measurements, no program用 read.csv 读入 / Import with read.csv

唯一需要下载的学习材料是企鹅原始数据表。到“导入企鹅”那节再下载即可。下面的按钮只下载 CSV，不下载网页源码或整套 R 代码。

The only required lesson download is the penguin data table. You can wait until the import lesson. This button downloads a CSV, not webpage source or a complete R program.

下载企鹅数据表 .csv / Download penguin data only

录音能确认老师用 R 展示 PCA，并建议研究中心化、尺度等问题；不能确认老师要求全部手写，还是给过现成代码。因此“逐步自己写”是这里为零基础学习选择的教法，不冒充老师的作业规定。

The recording establishes R demonstrations and suggested investigations of centering and scaling. It does not establish whether all code must be written from scratch or was supplied. Writing step by step is this guide’s teaching approach, not a claim about assessment rules.

手机：阅读中英对照、点击截图放大、答题、比较实验。Windows 电脑：打开 RStudio 实际写代码。网页里的“复制这一小段”只是方便粘贴，网页不会执行 R。

Phone: read both languages, enlarge screenshots, answer questions, and compare experiments. Windows computer: write and run code in RStudio. “Copy this block” helps you paste text; this webpage does not execute R.

LESSON 3 · 01

先装什么？R 和 RStudioInstall R first, then RStudio

录音能辨认出老师使用 R，以及 ggfortify、factoextra 等绘图工具。录音不能确认老师明确要求 RStudio；我推荐免费的 RStudio Desktop，因为写代码、看表格和看图都在一个窗口里。

The recording identifies R and plotting tools such as ggfortify and factoextra. It does not establish that RStudio was explicitly required. I recommend the free RStudio Desktop because it puts code, tables, and plots in one window.

名称 / Name大白话 / Plain meaning
R真正负责计算的程序。/ The program that performs calculations.
RStudio Desktop你操作 R 的工作台。装了它仍然需要 R。/ A workspace for using R; it still needs R.
package 软件包额外工具箱。这本教材的主线不用安装额外包。/ An extra toolbox; the core lesson needs none.

Windows：按这个顺序准备Windows: follow this order

  1. 打开 R 官方 Windows 下载页，点击页面上的 Download R … for Windows，下载 .exe 文件。版本数字更新是正常的。

  2. 双击下载的 R 安装文件，选择语言，阅读信息后点击 Next。安装目录使用安装器建议的目录；若没有管理员权限，选择当前用户可写的目录。保留默认组件和启动选项，等待完成后点击 Finish。

    Open the R installer, choose a language, read the information, and click Next. Use the suggested location, or a location writable by your account if you lack administrator access. Keep the default components and startup options, then wait and click Finish.

  3. 打开 Posit 官方下载页，选择免费的 RStudio Desktop。Windows 安装版：下载 .exe → 双击 → Next → Install → Finish。不要选 Server 或付费 Pro。

  4. 可选的 ZIP 方式：如果官方下载列表提供 Windows ZIP，右键 ZIP → 全部解压 → 选择固定文件夹 → 解压。打开解压后的文件夹，找到 rstudio.exe 并双击。本机截图采用这种方式，R 仍要先安装。

    ZIP alternative: if the official download list offers a Windows ZIP, right-click it → Extract All → choose a permanent folder → Extract. Find and open rstudio.exe in the extracted folder. This is the route used on this computer; R must still be installed first.

LESSON 3 · 03

先写代码，再保存：还没有运行Write and save before running

1 · 点击绿色加号旁的小箭头，再点 R Script1 · Open the green plus menu and choose R Script

2 · 点击左上编辑区第 1 行2 · Click line 1 in the top-left editor

切到英文输入法，先亲手输入第一行 1 + 1。按 Enter 换到下一行，Enter 在编辑区只换行。再照着下面逐行写，空行只是为了看清楚。

Switch to English punctuation and type 1 + 1 yourself. Enter in the editor starts a new line. Continue with the lines below; blank lines only improve readability.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
1 + 1

masses <- c(3000, 4000, 5000)
mean(masses)

plot(masses, type = "b")
这一行想做什么 / Intention怎么读 / Read it
1 + 1计算 1 加 1 / Add one and one

mean(masses)算这三个数的平均值 / Calculate their mean
plot(masses, type = "b")画出这三个数；b 表示点和连线都画 / Plot points and connecting lines

如果打字很慢：点某个代码框的“复制这一小段” → 回 RStudio → 点左上编辑区空白行 → Ctrl + V。粘贴只把文字放进去，不会自动运行。第一次请至少自己输入 1 + 1。

If typing is slow: Copy this block → return to RStudio → click a blank editor line → Ctrl + V. Pasting inserts text; it does not run it. Type at least 1 + 1 yourself on the first attempt.

LESSON 3 · 04

运行一行、选中几行、运行整份Run a line, a selection, or the whole script

1 · 点击 1 + 1 这一行，再点 Run1 · Click the 1 + 1 line, then Run

2 · 拖选创建 masses 和求平均数这两行2 · Drag to select the assignment and mean calculation

3 · 试一次 Source：从头运行整个小练习3 · Try Source: run the whole short script

Source 默认不会像逐行运行那样把每个裸表达式的值都显示出来。想在 Source 后也看到平均数，把 mean(masses) 改为 print(mean(masses))。没有打印不表示没有计算。

Source does not normally display every bare expression as interactive execution does. To show the mean when sourcing, replace mean(masses) with print(mean(masses)). No printed value does not imply no calculation.

现在把第二个体重 4000 改成 6000。先猜新的平均数，再重新选中“创建 masses + 求平均数”两行运行。应该约为 4666.667。只改文字、不重跑赋值行，内存中的 masses 不会改变。

Now change 4000 to 6000. Predict the mean, then rerun both the assignment and the mean line. Expect about 4666.667. Editing text without rerunning the assignment leaves the stored masses unchanged.

如果看到 / If you see怎么处理 / What to do
+ 提示符 / + prompt通常是括号或引号没写完。Esc 取消这一条，检查后完整重跑。/ Usually an unfinished bracket or quote. Cancel with Esc, check, and rerun the complete statement.
object 'masses' not found先运行 masses <- …，再求平均数。/ Run the assignment before the mean.
只有换行，没有结果 / New line, no output编辑区 Enter 只换行；运行用 Ctrl + Enter。/ Enter edits; Ctrl + Enter runs.
LESSON 3 · 05

先学会读这几个符号Read the small amount of R syntax you need

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
penguin_mass <- 4000
penguin_mass / 1000
masses <- c(3000, 4000, 5000)
mean(masses)
sd(masses)
# This line is a comment / 这行是注释
penguin_mass / 1000  → 4
mean(masses)        → 4000
sd(masses)          → 1000
符号 / Symbol怎么读 / How to read it
<-把右边的结果存到左边的名字里。/ Store the right-hand result under the name on the left.
c(…)把几个值合成一列向量。/ Combine values into a vector.
mean(masses)让 mean 函数计算 masses 的平均数。/ Ask the mean function to calculate the average.
sd(masses)计算样本标准差：数值有多分散。/ Calculate sample standard deviation: how spread out the values are.
"文字" / "text"引号告诉 R 这是文字，不是对象名。/ Quotes mark text rather than an object name.
#本行后面的内容是说明，不执行。/ The rest of the line is a comment.
TRUE / FALSE打开或关闭一个选项；必须用大写。/ Turn an option on or off; use capitals.
X[行, 列] / X[row, column]逗号前选行，后选列；留空表示全选。R 从 1 开始编号。/ Before the comma selects rows; after it selects columns. Blank means all. R counts from 1.
pca$x取出 pca 对象中名叫 x 的部分。/ Extract the component named x from pca.

先自己预测 masses[2] 是多少，再运行。然后把 4000 改成 6000，重新运行创建向量和计算平均数的两行。编辑代码本身不会自动更新对象。

Predict masses[2], then run it. Next change 4000 to 6000 and rerun both the vector assignment and the mean calculation. Editing text does not automatically update an object.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
masses[2]
masses <- c(3000, 6000, 5000)
mean(masses)
把代码改了但没运行，对象会更新吗？
Does editing code without running it update an object?

LESSON 3 · 08

挑选四项测量，处理缺失值Choose four measurements and handle missing values

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

先想：我们要比较的是企鹅的身体测量。品种和岛屿是标签，不是要放进本例 PCA 的数值测量。

First consider the inputs: body measurements. Species and island are labels, not numeric inputs to this PCA.

列 / Column意思 / Meaning
bill_length_mm喙长（毫米）/ Bill length (mm)
bill_depth_mm喙深（毫米）/ Bill depth (mm)
flipper_length_mm鳍长（毫米）/ Flipper length (mm)
body_mass_g体重（克）/ Body mass (g)
R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
variables <- c("bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm",
               "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g")
keep <- complete.cases(penguins[, variables])
penguins_clean <- penguins[keep, ]
X <- penguins_clean[, variables]
dim(X)
这一行 / Line为什么需要 / Why it is here
variables <- c(...)存好四个列名，避免反复写 / Store the four column names
penguins[, variables]逗号前空白＝所有行；后面＝指定列 / Blank before comma keeps all rows; after comma chooses columns
complete.cases(...)逐行检查这四个数是否齐全；得到 TRUE/FALSE / Check whether all four values exist in each row
penguins[keep, ]只留下检查为 TRUE 的行，暂时保留所有列 / Keep complete rows and all columns
penguins_clean[, variables]从干净的行中挑出四项测量，命名为 X / Choose the four measurements and name the table X

344 只中有 2 只缺少本例需要的测量，所以留下 342 只。我们没有因为 sex 缺失而删行，因为本例不用 sex。NA 不能当成零。

Two of 344 birds lack a required measurement, leaving 342. Missing sex does not remove a row because this example does not use sex. NA is not zero.

小练习：先预测 nrow(X) 和 ncol(X) 的答案，再各写一行运行。应该分别是 342 和 4。R 区分大小写，X 与 x 不是同一个名字。

Practice: predict nrow(X) and ncol(X), then type and run each. Expect 342 and 4. R is case-sensitive: X and x are different names.

可以把 species 直接当第五个测量放进 X 吗？
Should species be a fifth measurement in X?

LESSON 3 · 09

真正运行 PCA：这一行在做什么Run PCA and understand the result

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
pca <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca)
pca$sdev
pca$rotation
head(pca$x)

prcomp 是 R 自带的 PCA 函数。X 是输入表；center = TRUE 让每列减去本列平均数；scale. = TRUE 再除以本列样本标准差。scale. 末尾的点是参数名的一部分。pca 是我们给结果起的名字。

prcomp is R’s built-in PCA function. X is the input table; center = TRUE subtracts each column mean; scale. = TRUE then divides by its sample standard deviation. The dot in scale. belongs to the argument name. pca is our name for the result.

标准化的意思：体重多 1 个标准差和鳍长多 1 个标准差放到可比较的刻度上。它没有把所有企鹅变成一样，也没有把数据强行变成正态分布。

Standardising puts “one standard deviation above average” on a comparable scale for mass and flipper length. It neither makes all penguins identical nor forces a normal distribution.

输出 / Output看成什么 / Meaning本例大小 / Size
pca$xscores 得分：每只企鹅的新坐标 / New coordinates for each bird342 × 4
pca$rotation方向权重，常叫 loadings / Direction weights, often called loadings4 × 4
pca$sdev每个主成分的标准差 / Standard deviation of each PC4 个 / values
pca$sdev^2每个主成分的方差，即特征值 / Variances, the eigenvalues4 个 / values

scores 不是考试成绩。假如把地图转一个方向，你的位置有了新坐标，但你还是原来的那个人。PCA 对企鹅数据做的是类似的坐标变换；只留下前两个坐标，才发生降维。

Scores are not exam marks. Rotating a map changes your coordinates, not your identity. PCA makes a related change of coordinates for the penguins; dimensionality reduction happens when we retain only some coordinates.

哪一个给出“每只企鹅在 PC1 上的位置”？
Which gives each penguin’s PC1 coordinate?

LESSON 3 · 10

68.84% 到底是什么意思？What does 68.84% mean?

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
eigenvalues <- pca$sdev^2
variance_percent <- 100 * eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)
variance_percent
cumsum(variance_percent)
PC特征值 / Eigenvalue解释比例 / Share累计 / Cumulative
12.753868.84%68.84%
20.772519.31%88.16%
30.36529.13%97.29%
40.10852.71%100%

先把四个特征值加起来，本例为 4，因为四个输入变量已经各自标准化为方差 1。PC1 得到 2.7538，所以它占 2.7538 / 4 ≈ 68.84%。前两个合计 88.16%，意思是二维表示保留了这份标准化数据的大部分总方差。

The four eigenvalues sum to 4 because each standardised input has variance 1. PC1 has variance 2.7538, so its share is 2.7538 / 4 ≈ 68.84%. The first two retain 88.16% of the total variance in these standardised data.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
barplot(variance_percent, names.arg = paste0("PC", 1:4),
        ylab = "Explained variance (%)")

老师强调没有统一的必选阈值。二维图方便展示，但“超过 80% 就一定足够”不是普遍定理。应结合目的、后面轴的信息和可接受的信息损失来决定。

The lecturer emphasised that no single cutoff fits every problem. Two dimensions are easy to display, but “above 80% is always enough” is not a theorem. Consider the purpose, later PCs, and acceptable information loss.

PC1 和 PC2 一起保留多少？
How much do PC1 and PC2 retain together?

sum 把四个方差相加，/ 做除法，100 把比例变成百分数。cumsum 是从第一个数开始逐项累加。barplot 的第一个输入决定柱高，names.arg 决定柱名，ylab 决定纵轴文字。试着加上 col = "orange"，预测数值会不会改变。

sum adds the four variances; / divides; multiplying by 100 converts to percentages. cumsum adds successive values. In barplot, the first argument sets heights, names.arg sets labels, and ylab sets the vertical-axis title. Try col = "orange" and predict whether the numbers change.

这段只画位置，没有分组颜色。每个点是一只企鹅：横坐标来自 PC1，纵坐标来自 PC2。图上靠近，只说明它们在这两条轴上接近；剩下两条轴可能仍然不同。

This draws positions without group colours. Each point is a penguin: PC1 supplies its horizontal coordinate and PC2 its vertical coordinate. Nearby points are close on these two axes; they may still differ on the omitted axes.

在下面自己添加颜色代码。颜色是计算后加上的标签：算法没有用 species 来“学会分类”。因此这张图不能直接当作分类准确率。

Add the colour code below yourself. Colour is a label added after the calculation; PCA did not use species to learn a classifier. This plot is not a classification accuracy result.

自己给点上色Add colours yourself

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script

palette <- c("orange", "purple", "steelblue")

     col = palette[as.integer(species)], pch = 19,

       col = palette, pch = 19)

factor 把品种文字设为类别；as.integer 给每类编号；palette[编号] 给每只企鹅分配颜色；pch = 19 画实心点；legend 添加颜色说明。颜色不参与计算 PCA。先只画点，再加 legend 最容易看清变化。

factor defines categories; as.integer gives their codes; palette[codes] assigns colours; pch = 19 uses filled circles; legend adds the key. Colour does not enter the PCA calculation. Run the plot before adding the legend to see what each line does.

双标图：把样本和变量放在一起Biplot: show observations and variables together

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script

箭头指向某个变量相对增加的方向。沿箭头方向投影较远的点，一般与该变量较高的值有关。但 biplot 有自己的缩放方式，点和箭头的坐标刻度不同；不要把箭头末端直接读成毫米或克，也不要把各种绘图包的箭头长度硬比较。

An arrow indicates a direction of increasing values for a variable. Points projecting farther along it tend to have higher values of that variable. Biplots use a scaling convention, and point and arrow axes differ. Do not read arrow tips as millimetres or grams or compare lengths across plotting conventions.

同一条主成分方向的正负号可以一起翻转。你的图可能左右或上下镜像，只要得分和权重一致翻转，数学结果并没有变。

The sign of a PC direction is arbitrary. Your plot may be mirrored horizontally or vertically; if scores and weights flip together, the PCA solution is equivalent.

LESSON 3 · 13

组中心：一群点的平均位置Group centres: the average position of a group

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

把一个品种的 PC1 全部加起来除以只数，得到中心的横坐标；对 PC2 做同样的事，得到纵坐标。这个平均位置不一定刚好有一只真实企鹅站在那里。

Average PC1 within a species to obtain the centre’s horizontal coordinate; average PC2 for its vertical coordinate. No actual bird has to occupy that average position.

1 · 按品种分别求平均值1 · Calculate means within each species

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
centres <- aggregate(cbind(PC1, PC2) ~ species,
                     data = score_data, FUN = mean)
centres
片段 / Fragment怎么理解 / How to read it
aggregate按组汇总 / Summarise by group
cbind(PC1, PC2)把这两个待汇总的数值列放在一起 / Combine the two numeric columns
~ species按 species 分组；~ 不是赋值符号 / Group by species; ~ is not assignment
FUN = mean每组使用平均数这个函数 / Apply the mean function within each group
    species       PC1       PC2
1    Adelie   -1.4618    0.1327
2 Chinstrap   -0.3768   -0.9998
3    Gentoo    2.0028    0.3898

如果你的主成分正负号整体相反，中心也会一起翻转，这不是算错。不要只背这几个数字，重点是“按哪种标签、对哪些坐标求平均”。

If a PC’s signs are reversed, centres reverse with it; this is not an error. Focus on which labels define groups and which coordinates are averaged, rather than memorising the values.

2 · 先画点，再叠加大叉号和名字2 · Draw points, then overlay crosses and names

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
plot(score_data$PC1, score_data$PC2,
     col = adjustcolor(point_colours, alpha.f = 0.45), pch = 19,
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Crosses: group means")
points(centres$PC1, centres$PC2, pch = 4, cex = 2, lwd = 3,
       col = species_colours[as.character(centres$species)])
text(centres$PC1, centres$PC2, labels = centres$species,
     pos = 3, font = 2)

plot 开一张新图；points 在已有图上加符号；text 再加文字。pch = 4 是叉号，cex = 2 放大符号，lwd = 3 加粗，pos = 3 把名字放上方。adjustcolor 只让背景点半透明，不改变任何测量或得分。

plot starts a new plot; points overlays symbols; text adds names. pch = 4 gives crosses, cex = 2 enlarges them, lwd = 3 thickens lines, and pos = 3 places labels above. adjustcolor makes background points translucent without changing measurements or scores.

整体数据中心化后，所有样本的 PC 平均数接近零；这不要求每个品种的中心也为零。三组中心要按各组人数加权，才得到总体平均位置。这里的分组来自已知品种，不是 PCA 自动聚类的结果。

Centering makes the mean PC scores across all observations approximately zero, not each species mean. Weight group centres by group size to recover the overall mean. Groups here are known species labels, not clusters discovered by PCA.

大叉号一定对应一只真实企鹅吗？
Must a large cross correspond to a real penguin?

LESSON 3 · 14

椭圆：先认清它在描述什么Ellipses: first identify what they describe

老师把分组点外面加了椭圆。可以先把它看成一张“这群点大致怎样散开”的地图：中心在哪里、沿哪个方向更长、散布范围多大。读懂这层含义，再看代码。

The lecture drew ellipses around groups. First read them as a map of the point cloud: where its centre is, which direction it stretches, and how widely it spreads. Understand that before studying the code.

看到什么 / Feature可以怎么说 / Interpretation不能据此说 / Not established
中心 / Centre这组在 PC1–PC2 的平均位置 / The group’s mean PC1–PC2 position这个点就是某只典型企鹅 / That a real bird occupies the centre
长短方向 / Orientation某方向的散布更大 / Greater spread along one direction长轴一定是整体 PCA 的 PC1 / That it must align with the overall PC1
重叠 / Overlap这种二维表示下，两组的分布范围有重合 / The depicted two-dimensional group distributions overlap两组完全相同，或必然无法分类 / That groups are identical or cannot be classified
不重叠 / Separation这两轴上有较明显分离 / Clearer separation in these two coordinates分类准确率为 100% / 100% classification accuracy

“95%”不是“95% 分类正确”“95%” is not “95% correctly classified”

本页的轮廓把组内分布近似成二维正态，用样本均值和协方差估计位置与形状。在这个拟合模型下，轮廓内的概率为 95%。这不保证样本恰好有 95% 的点落在里面，也不保证未来数据满足正态模型。

These contours approximate each group by a bivariate normal distribution, using sample means and covariance estimates. Under that fitted model, 95% of probability lies inside the contour. This does not guarantee exactly 95% of the observed points lie inside or that future data follow the model.

椭圆类型 / Type问题 / Question
分布或集中椭圆 / Data or concentration ellipse组内个体通常怎样分散？/ How do individual observations spread?
均值的置信椭圆 / Confidence ellipse for a mean估计的总体均值有多不确定？/ How uncertain is the estimated population mean?

两类图不能混读。一般样本更多时，均值估计更精确；个体本身的散布不一定更小。factoextra 的 ellipse.type = "norm" 和 "confidence" 表示不同方法。看图前核对参数、图注和函数帮助。PCA 计算本身不要求正态分布。

Do not interchange these meanings. More observations generally improve mean precision without necessarily reducing individual spread. In factoextra, ellipse.type = "norm" and "confidence" select different methods. Check parameters, captions, and help. Computing PCA itself does not require normality.

动手：先为 Adelie 画一条轮廓Practice: draw one contour for Adelie

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

以下需要上一节的 score_data。第一次可以先理解图，再回来完成这三个小段；它会再次用到上节课的特征值分解。

Use score_data from the preceding lesson. You can first learn to read the figure and return to these three blocks; they reuse eigendecomposition from the earlier mathematics lesson.

1 · 取出这一组，测量它怎样散开1 · Select the group and describe its spread

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
adelie <- as.matrix(score_data[score_data$species == "Adelie", c("PC1", "PC2")])
group_mean <- colMeans(adelie)
group_cov <- cov(adelie)
eig_group <- eigen(group_cov)
theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)
unit_circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))

== 问“是否等于”，给每行 TRUE/FALSE。as.matrix 把两个坐标列变成数值矩阵；colMeans 按列求平均；cov 计算这组二维得分的协方差；eigen 得到长短方向与对应方差。这是组内二维协方差的特征分解，不是重新计算原始四变量的 PCA。

== tests equality row by row. as.matrix makes a numeric two-column matrix; colMeans computes its mean; cov measures the group’s score covariance; eigen finds its principal spread directions and variances. This is an eigendecomposition of within-group 2D covariance, not a new PCA of the four original measurements.

theta 是一圈角度；cos 与 sin 把它们变成单位圆上的 200 个点。你不必背住三角函数，先记住我们会把圆拉长、旋转，再移到组中心。

theta contains angles around a circle; cos and sin produce 200 unit-circle points. The next step stretches, rotates, and shifts that circle to the group mean.

2 · 拉伸、旋转，再移到中心2 · Stretch, rotate, then shift to the centre

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
radius <- sqrt(qchisq(0.95, df = 2))
ellipse_points <- radius * unit_circle %*%
  diag(sqrt(eig_group$values)) %*% t(eig_group$vectors)
ellipse_points <- sweep(ellipse_points, 2, group_mean, "+")

sqrt(特征值) 是两个方向的标准差，决定拉伸量；特征向量决定方向。%*% 做矩阵乘法；diag 把两个拉伸系数放在对角线上；sweep 的 2 表示按列，加上两列均值完成平移。

Square roots of eigenvalues give directional standard deviations and set the stretching; eigenvectors set directions. %*% performs matrix multiplication; diag places stretches on the diagonal; sweep with 2 adds column means to shift the contour.

qchisq(0.95, df = 2) 给二维正态标准距离平方的 95% 阈值，开平方后 radius 约为 2.448。它不是普通的一维 ±1.96 规则，也不是 PCA 的解释方差。

qchisq(0.95, df = 2) gives the 95% threshold for squared standardised distance in two normal dimensions. Its square root is about 2.448. This is not the one-dimensional ±1.96 rule or PCA explained variance.

3 · 把点、轮廓和中心画在一起3 · Plot points, contour, and centre

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
plot(adelie, pch = 19, col = "#C45B1270", asp = 1,
     xlim = range(adelie[, 1], ellipse_points[, 1]),
     ylim = range(adelie[, 2], ellipse_points[, 2]),
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Adelie: fitted normal 95% contour")
lines(ellipse_points, col = "#C45B12", lwd = 2)
points(group_mean[1], group_mean[2], pch = 4, cex = 2, lwd = 3)

plot 开新图，lines 加轮廓，points 加中心。xlim/ylim 把点和轮廓都包括在视野内。先预测把 0.95 改成 0.80 会怎样，再从 radius 那行重跑到最后：轮廓会缩小，企鹅位置与 PCA 都不变。

plot starts the figure; lines adds the contour; points marks the centre. xlim/ylim include both observations and contour. Predict the effect of changing 0.95 to 0.80, then rerun from radius onward: the contour shrinks while penguin scores and PCA remain unchanged.

进阶：重复三次，画全部品种 / Extension: repeat for all species
R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
plot(score_data$PC1, score_data$PC2,
     col = adjustcolor(point_colours, alpha.f = 0.4), pch = 19,
     xlim = c(-4, 5), ylim = c(-4, 4), asp = 1,
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Fitted normal contours, not class boundaries")
for (group_name in levels(score_data$species)) {
  group_xy <- as.matrix(score_data[score_data$species == group_name, c("PC1", "PC2")])
  group_mean <- colMeans(group_xy)
  eig_group <- eigen(cov(group_xy))
  edge <- radius * unit_circle %*%
    diag(sqrt(eig_group$values)) %*% t(eig_group$vectors)
  edge <- sweep(edge, 2, group_mean, "+")
  lines(edge, col = species_colours[group_name], lwd = 2)
  points(group_mean[1], group_mean[2], pch = 4, cex = 1.6, lwd = 2)
}
legend("topright", legend = names(species_colours),
       col = species_colours, lwd = 2, bty = "n")

for 每次把 group_name 换成一个品种，重复花括号内的同一组动作。先完成一个品种，才需要学这段循环。这里沿用 0.95 的 radius；如果你刚改成 0.80，先改回去。

for gives group_name one species at a time and repeats the actions inside braces. Learn one species before the loop. This reference uses radius for 0.95; restore it if you just changed to 0.80.

两个 95% 椭圆重叠，能直接说分类器一定分不清吗？

LESSON 3 · 15

相关圆：这些箭头有什么关系？Correlation circle: how are the variables related?

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
correlations <- cor(X, pca$x)
round(correlations[, 1:2], 3)

cor 计算相关系数。圆图中一个变量的横坐标是它与 PC1 的相关，纵坐标是它与 PC2 的相关。它不是“变量本身的特征向量”。

cor calculates correlations. A variable’s horizontal coordinate is its correlation with PC1; its vertical coordinate is its correlation with PC2. It is not a separate eigenvector belonging to that variable.

  1. 先看轴名：Correlation with PC1 / PC2，范围与相关系数有关。

    First read the axes: Correlation with PC1 / PC2.

  2. 再看箭头长度：越接近圆周，变量越能由这两个主成分表示；短箭头说明还有较多信息在其他轴。

    Next inspect length: proximity to the circle indicates good representation by these two PCs; a short arrow leaves more information on other axes.

  3. 最后看夹角：两变量都在平面中表示得好时，小夹角通常表示正相关，反向表示负相关，近直角表示相关较弱。二维图只给近似，想确认就算 cor。

    Finally inspect angles: when both variables are well represented, a small angle suggests positive correlation, opposite directions negative correlation, and a right angle weak correlation. This is a two-dimensional approximation; confirm with cor.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
cor(X$flipper_length_mm, X$body_mass_g)

PCA 计算本身不要求数据服从正态分布。老师提到的某些分组椭圆可能带有分布假设，那是画椭圆的假设，不能直接搬成 PCA 的前提。

Computing PCA does not require normal data. Some group ellipses discussed in class may rely on distributional assumptions; those assumptions belong to the ellipse method, not automatically to PCA.

自己画出相关圆：分三小段运行Draw the circle in three small blocks

先准备坐标和圆周：seq 在 0 到 2π 之间取 200 个点；cos、sin 给圆周坐标。

Prepare coordinates and the circle: seq takes 200 values from 0 to 2π; cos and sin give circle coordinates.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
xy <- correlations[, 1:2]
angle <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)

再画圆和十字轴：type = "l" 连线；asp = 1 让横纵单位长度相等。

Draw the circle and reference axes: type = "l" draws lines; asp = 1 uses equal axis scales.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
plot(cos(angle), sin(angle), type = "l", asp = 1,
     xlab = "Correlation with PC1", ylab = "Correlation with PC2")
abline(h = 0, v = 0, col = "grey")

最后从原点向四个变量的坐标画箭头，再加名字。length 控制箭头尖的尺寸，不改变相关系数。

Finally draw arrows from the origin to the four variable coordinates and add names. length sets the arrowhead size, not the correlations.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
arrows(0, 0, xy[, 1], xy[, 2], length = 0.08, col = "steelblue")
text(0.7 * xy[, 1], 0.7 * xy[, 2],
     labels = rownames(xy), cex = 0.65)
LESSON 3 · 16

三个容易混淆的量Three quantities that answer different questions

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

量 / Quantity到底问什么 / Question本例 / Example
解释方差 / Explained variancePC1 留住全部数据的多少变异？/ What share of total variation does PC1 retain?68.84%
变量贡献 / Variable contribution形成 PC1 时，鳍长占多大一份？/ How much does flipper length contribute to PC1?33.18%
变量 cos² / Variable cos²鳍长自身的变异，有多少被 PC1 表示？/ How well does PC1 represent flipper length?0.9137 ≈ 91.37%

大白话：解释方差看“这一轴对整份数据”；contribution 看“哪些变量构成这一轴”；cos² 看“这一轴有没有把这个变量讲清楚”。分母不一样，所以不能混着比较。这里讲的是变量指标，不是单个样本点的贡献或 cos²。

In plain terms: explained variance asks about one axis and the whole dataset; contribution asks which variables make up that axis; cos² asks how well the axis represents a particular variable. Their denominators differ. These are variable metrics, not individual-point contributions or cos².

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
contribution <- 100 * pca$rotation^2
cos2 <- cor(X, pca$x)^2
contribution[, 1]
cos2[, 1]
rowSums(cos2[, 1:2])

对本例的标准化 PCA，若权重为 v，特征值为 λ：相关系数 r = √λ × v；变量贡献 = 100v²；变量 cos² = r² = λv²。每条轴的所有变量贡献加起来 100%；一个变量跨全部四轴的 cos² 加起来 1。

For this standardised PCA, with weight v and eigenvalue λ: correlation r = √λ × v; variable contribution = 100v²; variable cos² = r² = λv². Contributions across variables sum to 100% for each axis; a variable’s cos² across all four axes sums to 1.

鳍长的 PC1 cos² = 0.9137，是说 PC1 解释全部数据的 91.37% 吗？
Does flipper length’s PC1 cos² of 0.9137 mean PC1 explains 91.37% of the whole dataset?

把你算的贡献画出来Plot the contributions you calculated

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
barplot(contribution[, 1], names.arg = c("Bill L", "Bill D", "Flipper", "Mass"),
        ylab = "Contribution (%)", main = "PC1")
abline(h = 25, lty = 2)

这次柱高来自 contribution 的第一列。h = 25 在高度 25 画水平线，lty = 2 表示虚线。自己把第一列改为第二列，并把标题改为 PC2，看看谁占得最多。

Bar heights come from the first column of contribution. h = 25 draws a horizontal reference; lty = 2 makes it dashed. Change the column to 2 and title to PC2; identify the largest contribution.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script

ggplot2:: 指定从哪个包找函数；加载 ggfortify 后，它为 prcomp 结果提供 autoplot 方法。data 提供对应行的标签；colour 和 shape 是列名。这里 scale = 0 保留原始 scores 的显示尺度；它是绘图参数，不是 prcomp 的 scale. = TRUE，也不会重算 PCA。

ggplot2:: identifies the package supplying the function; ggfortify adds an autoplot method for prcomp objects. data supplies matching labels; colour and shape name columns. Here scale = 0 keeps the raw score scale for display. This plot argument differs from prcomp’s scale. = TRUE and does not refit PCA.

loadings.label = TRUE显示变量名字 / Label variable arrows

两段分别运行，观察每次新增了什么。不同包可能重缩放坐标、箭头或使用不同有限样本校正；先看轴名、图例与参数，再比较。没有完全一样的外观不代表 PCA 变了。

Run the calls separately and identify what each adds. Packages can rescale coordinates/arrows or use different finite-sample adjustments. Read axes, legends, and parameters before comparing; a different appearance need not mean different PCA.

4 · factoextra：名字对应图的对象4 · factoextra: function names identify what is shown

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
factoextra::fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE)
factoextra::fviz_pca_ind(pca, geom.ind = "point",
                       habillage = factor(penguins_clean$island),
                       addEllipses = TRUE, ellipse.type = "norm",
                       ellipse.level = 0.95, mean.point = TRUE)

先单独运行 fviz_eig，看解释率；再运行 fviz_pca_ind 看样本。habillage 指分组标签；这里按岛屿分组。mean.point = TRUE 加组中心，ellipse.level = 0.95 指轮廓水平，不是保留 95% 的 PCA 方差。

Run fviz_eig for explained variance, then fviz_pca_ind for observations. habillage supplies group labels, here islands. mean.point = TRUE adds group centres; ellipse.level = 0.95 sets the contour level, not retained PCA variance.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script

factoextra::fviz_pca_var(pca, axes = c(1, 2), col.var = "contrib")
factoextra::fviz_contrib(pca, choice = "var", axes = 1)
factoextra::fviz_contrib(pca, choice = "var", axes = 2)

这四条分开运行。var 是变量图；contrib 是贡献条形图；choice = "var" 指变量贡献。第一张按 PC1–PC2 平面的 cos² 上色，表示两轴合计的表示质量。第二张按所选平面的贡献指标上色，不能直接把颜色读成仅 PC1 的贡献。要问“谁构成 PC1”，看 axes = 1 的条形图；换成 2 就问 PC2。

Run these four calls separately. var plots variables; contrib plots contributions; choice = "var" requests variable contributions. The first colour scale uses representation quality across PC1–PC2. The second uses the selected-plane contribution metric, not PC1 alone. Use the axes = 1 bar chart to ask which variables build PC1; axes = 2 asks about PC2.

LESSON 3 · 18

老师建议的实验：改单位会怎样？The suggested investigation: what if units change?

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

先预测：同一只企鹅 4000 克 = 4 千克，动物没变；PCA 是否也应该完全不变？先不要急着看答案，要区分是否标准化。

Predict first: 4000 grams and 4 kilograms describe the same bird. Must PCA remain unchanged? Distinguish standardised from unstandardised PCA before answering.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
pca_unscaled <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
X_kg <- X
X_kg$body_mass_g <- X_kg$body_mass_g / 1000
pca_kg_raw <- prcomp(X_kg, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_kg_scaled <- prcomp(X_kg, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

FALSE 只关掉除以标准差，中心化仍然打开。X_kg 是复制的数据；为方便比较，body_mass_g 这个列名保留了，但里面的值现在是千克。这些行直接追加在你自己的脚本里，然后用下面的命令检查结果。

FALSE disables division by standard deviation while centering stays on. X_kg is a copy; its column keeps the name body_mass_g for comparison, but now contains kilograms. Append these lines to your own script, then inspect the results using the commands below.

点按钮比较真实 R 输出：这里只切换已经算好的结果，不是在手机上重新跑 R。

Tap to compare actual R output. This switches precomputed results; it does not rerun R on your phone.

PC1
PC2
PC3
PC4

以克计、不标准化：PC1 约 99.99%。改为千克、不标准化：约 91.97%。这不是突然发现了更多或更少的生物学信息，而是各列的数值尺度改变了。标准化后两种单位都回到约 68.84%，因为单位倍数在减均值、除标准差时抵消了。

In grams without standardisation, PC1 explains about 99.99%; in kilograms, about 91.97%. This reflects a change in numerical weighting, not newly discovered biological information. With standardisation, both give about 68.84%, because the unit multiplier cancels when subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation.

不要把“解释率更高”自动当作“更合理”。也不要认为标准化永远正确：当原始量纲的大小差异本身就是你关心的信息时，不标准化可能有理由。选择要符合问题。

A higher explained percentage is not automatically a better analysis. Standardisation is not always the right choice either: original-scale differences may be meaningful for a particular question. Justify the choice.

把克改成千克后，标准化 PCA 的特征值会怎样？
What happens to eigenvalues after changing grams to kilograms in standardised PCA?

在自己的 Console 核对三个结果Check three results in your own Console

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
100 * pca_unscaled$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_unscaled$sdev^2)
100 * pca_kg_raw$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_kg_raw$sdev^2)
100 * pca_kg_scaled$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_kg_scaled$sdev^2)
99.98913
91.96926
68.84388

每行都在算“第一项 / 所有项的和 × 100”。先看对象名，确认你比较的是哪次实验。这里只查看结果，没有自动保存图片。

Each line calculates first variance / total variance × 100. Check the object name to identify the experiment. These commands inspect results without automatically saving images.

LESSON 3 · 19

中心化：先把平均位置放回原点Centering: move the average to the origin

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

中心化是每列减去平均数，例如 3000、4000、5000 克变成 −1000、0、1000 克。它没有改变任意两只企鹅的体重差，只改变了我们从哪里开始量位置。

Centering subtracts the mean: 3000, 4000, 5000 grams become −1000, 0, 1000 grams. It preserves differences between birds while changing the origin from which positions are measured.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
a <- c(3000, 4000, 5000)
a - mean(a)
[1] -1000 0 1000

为了只研究中心化，我们先固定各列的除数，再比较是否减均值。否则同时改变两件事，就很难判断差异来自哪里。下面代码接着写在自己的脚本里。

To isolate centering, fix the divisor for each column before comparing subtraction of the mean. Changing both factors at once makes interpretation harder. Append this block to your own script.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
sample_sd <- sapply(X, sd)
X_fixed_scale <- sweep(as.matrix(X), 2, sample_sd, "/")
fit_centered <- prcomp(X_fixed_scale, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
fit_uncentered <- prcomp(X_fixed_scale, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

sapply(X, sd) 对每列计算标准差；as.matrix 把数值表变成矩阵；sweep 的 2 表示按列操作，"/" 表示除法。因此同一列在两次实验中使用同一个除数。

sapply(X, sd) computes each column’s standard deviation; as.matrix converts the table to a matrix; 2 in sweep means work by columns and "/" means division. Both fits therefore use the same divisors.

本例中心化后的 PC1 方差比例为 68.84%；未中心化输出的约 99.28% 是相对原点的平方和（能量）比例，不能把它直接当成同一个“围绕均值的方差比例”来比较。

Here the centred PC1 variance share is 68.84%. The uncentred value of about 99.28% describes squared energy about zero, not the same variance-about-the-mean criterion.

R 的一个细节：scale(X, center = FALSE, scale = TRUE) 的除数不是上面那组样本标准差，而是基于相对零点平方和的量。研究中心化时固定除数，可以避开这个混淆。

An R detail: scale(X, center = FALSE, scale = TRUE) does not use the same sample standard deviations; it uses divisors based on sums of squares about zero. Fixing divisors avoids this confounding change.

再做一个更容易解释的实验One more experiment that is easier to explain

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
X_shifted <- X
X_shifted$bill_length_mm <- X_shifted$bill_length_mm + 1000
fit_shifted <- prcomp(X_shifted, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
max(abs(pca$sdev - fit_shifted$sdev))

结果应接近 0。给整列加 1000 后，这一列的平均数也加 1000；减去平均数后，增加的常数正好抵消。这就是中心化 PCA 对平移不变。

The result should be close to zero. Adding 1000 to every value also adds 1000 to the mean, so centering cancels the added constant. This is translation invariance of centred PCA.

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
100 * fit_centered$sdev[1]^2 / sum(fit_centered$sdev^2)
100 * fit_uncentered$sdev[1]^2 / sum(fit_uncentered$sdev^2)
68.84388
99.28380
LESSON 3 · 20

接上上节课：公式里的东西在哪？Connect this lesson to the mathematics

操作固定为：在自己的 penguin_practice.R 末尾新起一行 → 写下本节的小段代码 → 鼠标选中这一整段 → Ctrl + Enter → 在 Console 或 Plots 核对结果。不要把 >、[1] 或结果数字抄进脚本。

For each block: start a new line at the end of your own penguin_practice.R → write the block → select all of it → press Ctrl + Enter → inspect Console or Plots. Do not copy prompts, [1], or output numbers into your script.

先把字母对应好：X 是清洗后的原始测量表；Z 是中心化、标准化后的表；V 是方向矩阵，也就是 pca$rotation；T 是得分矩阵，也就是 pca$x。

Match the symbols first: X is the cleaned measurement table; Z is the centred and standardised table; V is the direction matrix, pca$rotation; T is the score matrix, pca$x.

T = ZV　　(342 × 4)(4 × 4) → 342 × 4
R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
Z <- scale(X, center = pca$center, scale = pca$scale)
T_manual <- Z %*% pca$rotation
max(abs(T_manual - pca$x))

%*% 是矩阵乘法；普通 * 是对应元素相乘。上面最后的数应接近 0，表示手动计算的新坐标和 R 的输出一致。本机的主脚本已经通过这一核对。

%*% is matrix multiplication; ordinary * multiplies matching elements. The final value should be near zero, showing that manually calculated coordinates match R’s output. This check passed in the main script here.

PC1 ≈ 0.455 zbill length − 0.400 zbill depth + 0.576 zflipper + 0.548 zmass

这是本例一个企鹅的第一坐标的计算方法，z 是标准化后的测量，不是原始毫米和克。鳍长与体重在这个方向有较大正权重，喙深为负。整组权重同时变号也表示同一条轴。

This calculates one bird’s first coordinate. The z values are standardised measurements, not raw millimetres or grams. Flipper length and mass have relatively large positive weights; bill depth has a negative weight. Reversing all signs gives the same axis.

SVD 在这里没有消失SVD is still behind the calculation

Z = UDVᵀ
ZᵀZ / (n − 1) = V[D² / (n − 1)]Vᵀ
T = ZV = UD

prcomp 使用 SVD。V 给出方向；奇异值 dᵢ 的平方除以 n−1 给出特征值；所以 pca$sdev = dᵢ / √(n−1)。这样就把上节课的特征值/SVD和本节课的软件输出接起来了。

prcomp uses SVD. V supplies the directions; dᵢ²/(n−1) supplies the eigenvalues; therefore pca$sdev = dᵢ/√(n−1). This connects the previous lesson’s decomposition to the software output.

能不能变回原来的数据？Can we reconstruct the data?

R · 在脚本中运行 / Run in your script
Z_all <- pca$x %*% t(pca$rotation)
Z_two <- pca$x[, 1:2] %*% t(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
max(abs(Z - Z_all))
mean((Z - Z_two)^2)
X_reconstructed <- sweep(Z_all, 2, pca$scale, "*")
X_reconstructed <- sweep(X_reconstructed, 2, pca$center, "+")

t 是转置。保留全部四轴时，可以恢复 Z（只有数值误差）；只保留两轴时通常只能近似恢复。最后两行先乘回标准差，再加回平均数，才回到原来的毫米和克。

t means transpose. All four PCs reconstruct Z up to numerical error; two PCs generally provide an approximation. Multiply by standard deviations and add means to return to millimetres and grams.

这一节可以第二遍再读。第一次先能在图上指出“点的坐标”和“方向权重”，再回来看矩阵乘法会更容易。

You can leave this section for a second pass. First identify scores and direction weights in the plots; the matrix multiplication will then be easier to follow.

PCA 图上两个组中心不同，可以立刻宣布差异显著吗？
Do different group centres immediately establish statistical significance?

Does reducing an ellipse level from 0.95 to 0.80 change PC1 explained variance?

口头检查答案：自己先说，再展开 / Speak first, then reveal

① PC1/PC2 是每只企鹅的新坐标，颜色与形状是外加标签。② 组中心是平均坐标，轮廓描述所选模型下的组内散布，不是分类器。③ 68.84% 对整份标准化数据；33.18% 是鳍长对 PC1 的变量贡献；0.9137 是 PC1 对鳍长的表示质量。④ 标准化抵消正的单位倍数，中心化抵消整列常数平移。⑤ 全部得分与方向可重建预处理数据，原单位还要还原标准差和均值。

① PC1/PC2 are new coordinates; colour and shape are added labels. ② A centre is a mean; a contour describes group spread under its chosen model, not a classifier. ③ 68.84% concerns total standardised variation; 33.18% is flipper length’s contribution to PC1; 0.9137 is PC1’s representation of flipper length. ④ Standardisation cancels positive unit multipliers, and centering cancels column-wise constant shifts. ⑤ All scores and directions reconstruct preprocessed data; original units also require reversing scaling and centering.

学会的标准不是“这一页都看过”，而是能不复制整份脚本完成一次分析，并解释自己的图。若只能跟着点击，先把相应小段再做一遍，不急着增加新函数。

Completion means rebuilding an analysis without copying a whole script and explaining your own figures. If you can only follow clicks, repeat the relevant small block before adding more functions.

课堂英语：听到这个词，就想到这个动作Classroom vocabulary: connect each word to an action

English中文与动作 / Meaning and action
observation / variable一行企鹅 / 一列测量。/ A row / a measurement column.
centre / scale减平均数 / 调整尺度，本例除以标准差。/ Subtract means / adjust scale, here divide by SD.
scores / loadings样本的新坐标 / 方向权重；不同包的 loadings 定义需核对。/ Sample coordinates / direction weights; check the package convention.

我用四项数值测量计算 PCA，品种只用于给图上色。中心化和标准化之后，前两个主成分保留了约 88.16% 的总方差。关掉标准化时，体重的数值尺度会强烈影响结果。

I used four numeric measurements for PCA and used species only to colour the plot. After centering and standardising, the first two PCs retained about 88.16% of the total variance. Without standardisation, the numerical scale of body mass strongly influenced the result.
